candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeouts but no redis-side metrics/logs to confirm whether the fault is redis itself or inventory's redis client; gateway logs were excluded.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout, matching the alert's ~2s 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; redis-side evidence is still needed to fully localize the fault.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics or logs to confirm redis as the failing dependency
Inventory service metrics/logs to distinguish redis fault from inventory client-side timeout
